請填寫每個記憶體池的增量預算，無需配置時可填 0。: Enter an incremental budget for each memory pool. Enter 0 for a pool that needs no allocation.
記憶體預算必須是有限的非負數值。: Enter a finite, nonnegative memory budget.
請選擇此候選管線的成功執行。: Choose a successful run of this pipeline.
量測預留百分比必須是 0 到 100 的整數。: Enter a measurement margin from 0 to 100 percent.
請先讀取目前管線與節點配置。: Read the current pipeline and node configuration first.
請填寫預算依據及適用條件。: Enter the basis and conditions for this budget.
瀏覽器須支援無損 JSON 數值才能提交核准配置。: This browser needs lossless JSON numbers to submit an approved placement.
缺少與目前形狀相符的資源量測或預算: Provide a measurement or budget matching this workload
預算對應的設定已變更，請重新讀取節點配置: The measured configuration changed. Read the node configuration again
元件的資源群組正忙: The component resource group is busy

無法驗證節點現況: The node state could not be verified
檢視節點、精度與卸載設定: View nodes, precision and offload settings
